### TL;DR

1-2 sentences: motivations, changes, concerns, etc.

## Motivations

Omit if obvious, e.g. small {bug fix, improvement}

## Changes

- If worthwhile, describe a before/after (especially for UI changes). E.g. via a table:
  | | Before | After |
  | - | - | - |
  | Thing1 | it sucks | it sucks less |
  | Thing2 | dne | e |
- If UI, upload screen{shots, recordings} (paste uploaded video URL in a `<video src="" />`, otherwise GH won't render it)

### Concerns, extra thoughts, etc.?

None.

## How to review

E.g. which files to start from, what needs more/less attention, how to reproduce bugs

## Checklist

- [] Switch from `draft` to `open` once ready for review
- [] Add a codeowner to review
- [] Review it yourself. You may want to comment on files in-line
